## Changes
- Error messages now say what went wrong in plain words, instead of internal names like "accessDenied" or "The operation couldn't be completed": a microphone or system audio that won't start (with the setting to check), a recording whose audio can't be read, a reply from Gemini that couldn't be read, a call whose audio couldn't be recovered after a crash, and failed model downloads. - Banners at the top of the window (Undo after moving to the Trash, imports) slide in and out instead of pushing the page down at once, and a call moved to the Trash disappears smoothly; Undo brings it back the same way. - The red dot in the recording pill gently pulses while Ahoy is recording. - The transcription percentage counts up instead of jumping. - Copying a call's insights shows a checkmark for a moment, so you know it worked. - With Reduce motion on in System Settings, all of these happen instantly.

## Changes
- Scrolling the Dashboard and Action items is smooth again in a big library; with a few hundred calls, Action items could stall for up to a second at a time. - Save Diagnostics… and Save Diagnostics Report… no longer freeze Ahoy while they build the zip (up to half a minute when old recordings had to come back from iCloud). - Starting or stopping a recording no longer pauses Ahoy for a moment while the chime plays. - On a call's screen, only one thing rewrites the insights at a time: Regenerate, Generate, Transcribe again, Ask and Translate now wait while another of them, or an assistant reply, is still running, so one can no longer silently overwrite the other.

## Changes
- In Settings, the Start Recording button now lines up with the settings cards, left of the category list, instead of sitting at the window's edge. - The Back button no longer shows a clipped label right after the window is resized.
